title: Schema for the campaign story missions data file (five have no card, only a map: their image and back_id are null)

id.description: Id for entry: a UUID (see docs/data-model.md).

back_id.description: Foreign key to this card's back in data/card-backs.json; null for a story mission without a card.

image.description: The file path for this story mission's card image; null for a story mission without a card.
